evals.prompt: Clip this podcast into shorts: <path to a ~2 min talk video>
evals.expected_output: 3-5 vertical clips, each rendered via studio render, each passing studio check, contact sheets viewed, handed over without posting.
expectations: Transcribed the source with `npm run studio -- transcribe`
Each clip has its own spec.json with a hook of 2-6 words
Each clip is 15-90 s and starts on its hook line
Ran `studio check` on every output and every check passed
Looked at the contact sheet image for each clip
Did not call /hq:publish or any posting tool
